architecture.mechanism: Mechanical activation of Golgi tendon organ feedback via twitch contractions acting as a physiological stimulus that induces intermuscular effects
architecture.intervention: Integrate a mechanical tension-sensing element in the steering column and starter circuit that requires a specific active mechanical input (analogous to a twitch contraction) from an authorized key or fob to release the immobilizer, preventing engine activation and steering mobility when the required mechanical stimulus is absent
architecture.expected_effect: The starting system prevents unauthorized engine activation and forward mobility by requiring active mechanical stimulation of the sensor, satisfying FMVSS requirements for an immobilizer without relying solely on passive electrical authentication
architecture.falsification_test: Attempt to start the vehicle and turn the steering column using only passive electrical signal injection without applying the required mechanical twitch stimulus; failure to prevent engine cranking or steering rotation falsifies the intervention
